content.heroHeading: Building Tech Equity Through Smart Reuse
content.heroSubtext: We recover, refurbish, and redistribute technology to close digital gaps while reducing environmental waste.
content.whyText: We design efficient pathways from donation to deployment, ensuring useful devices reach people who need them most.
content.missionSubtext: Structured programs that improve access, sustainability, and community outcomes.
content.missionCard1Text: We streamline collection, sorting, and deployment to reduce waste and improve turnaround.
content.missionCard2Text: Donated devices are securely cleaned, repaired, and validated before distribution.
content.missionCard3Text: We prioritize equitable access so technology can unlock education and opportunity.
content.impactSubtext: Performance metrics that show measurable outcomes.
content.programsSubtext: A guided experience for donors, volunteers, and recipients.
content.program1Text: Schedule pickup, track acceptance, and receive impact updates.
content.program2Text: Join refurbishment events, logistics teams, and outreach drives.
content.program3Text: Apply for devices and receive personalized onboarding support.
content.contactSubtext: Tell us how you want to partner and we will follow up.

footer.brandText: Connecting communities with technology access through sustainable engineering workflows.
